segments.text: proposition 1 CHildren muſt not for their wiues ſake ſo leaue their parents, as not to ſuccour or reuerence them, albeit they are bound to liue néerer to their wiues, than to their parents.

proposition 2 Whereas the huſband and wife are ſaid to be one fleſh, matrimonie is declared to be inſeparable, ſo long as they can be one fleſh; which is taken awaie by adulterie, and for want of power to performe the dutie of marriage one towards another.
proposition 3 Matrimonie is therefore ſaid to be a myſterie, bicauſe it repreſenteth vnto vs the moſt ſtreict coniunction of Chriſt with his church.

proposition 4 The church immediatelie from hir beginning had Adam for hir gouernour, not without the word of God: for he, being indued with the ſpirit of GOD, ſpake with the ſelfe-ſame words, both as touching Chriſt, and as touching matrimonie.

proposition 5
Temptations are therfore permitted by God, bicauſe they be profitable for the church.
proposition 6 The diuell promiſed vnto the woman thoſe things, which ſhe had alreadie; to wit, the opening of the eies, and likeneſſe to God.
